errors.text_span: Вноса и износа се развиват паралелно, като износът почти винаги е по-малък от вноса
errors.evidence: The description makes a comparison that exports are almost always smaller than imports and that they develop in parallel. The prompt explicitly forbids making comparisons and interpretations about the data.

errors.text_span: с изключение на 2008 г., когато износът (15,3 млрд. EUR) е по-голям от вноса (25,2 млрд. EUR)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that in 2008, exports (15.3 billion EUR) were greater than imports (25.2 billion EUR). The numerical values are identified correctly, but the comparison is false (15.3 is not greater than 25.2). In the chart, the import value is larger than the export value for every year, including 2008.
